recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future Vocabulary decision changes the ConceptMap.group.unmapped.otherMap constraint itself.
issue_request: FHIR-13738 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Vocabulary issue for ConceptMap. It reported that cmd-3 said a code must be provided even though the invariant tested url.exists(), and requested changing the human text to say a url must be provided.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in commit 677b2ad4b882af827f8a3dc5a1bcbe49b79b9db6, svn revision 13449, which changed the old source/conceptmap/conceptmap-spreadsheet.xml cmd-3 human text from code to url.
additional_context: ConceptMap is active in source/fhir.ini. The old spreadsheet source was replaced by source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml in the 2021 source refactor, and later ConceptMap cleanup renamed ConceptMap.group.unmapped.url to ConceptMap.group.unmapped.otherMap while preserving URL/canonical-map semantics. Current fhir.ini records the url-to-otherMap rename, and community/Jira neighborhood searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml says, for cmd-3, that if mode is other-map, a url for the other map must be provided, and the expression requires otherMap.exists().
